# Longdo Traffic event fixture

The events were cut on 3 October 2026 from `https://event.longdo.com/feed/json` for the Bangkok
flood pilot (ADR-0048). No key is needed and none was used.

- **Source:** Longdo Traffic (Metamedia Technology). The events were contributed by the
  Department of Highways ("DOH Admin"), iTIC and Longdo users.
- **Licence:** not stated. Credit Longdo Traffic, DOH and iTIC.
- **Redacted:** descriptions are replaced. Contributor usernames other than "DOH Admin" and
  "itic_user" become `itic.staff` or `someone`.
- **Added:** the last event is a copy of the first, moved to Chiang Mai, to test the region rule.
- **Purpose:** test input only. Never edit it to make a test pass.
